issue_context.title: HomeKit media player loses source list
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have a TV which I have exposed to HomeKit as a media player through the HomeKit integration.  The TV is a Sony Bravia TV.  I have it setup in accessory mode and it is the only entity in the HomeKit bridge.  After I pair it to HomeKit everything works and I can change sources and turn it on/off.  After a few hours to a day later, the HomeKit accessory no longer shows a source list and only has a power button showing.  If I reload the HomeKit bridge from HA the source list shows up again, but every entry is renamed to the name of the device.  The source list works, but the names are all wrong.  I have to remove the accessory from HomeKit then pair it again for the source list to be correct.  Then it repeats all over after a few hours.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2023.2

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

HomeKit

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit/

### Diagnostics information

[config_entry-homekit-ed31e1f983b03a2a2bcec4dec16eaa78.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/10936055/config_entry-homekit-ed31e1f983b03a2a2bcec4dec16eaa78.json.txt)
